verdict.summary: The round-2 diff remains correct and complete. The REST issues fetch uses exhaustive pagination with slurped pages, excludes pull requests, fails closed at the snapshot ceiling, and filters only issues lacking an area label. Apply behavior derives park removal from each issue's own labels while retaining the empty-add guard, so never-parked issues only gain validated area labels. The focused suite passes all 29 tests, including real fetch-shape reach/truncation guards and end-to-end per-issue apply behavior. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-vacuity defect is evident. Compared with round 1, the approved change and zero-findings result are materially unchanged, so progress is stagnant under the required scale.
